data.name: Supreetha
data.long_meaning: The name Supreetha means 'Graceful, Beautiful'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'supra' meaning 'above' and 'rith' meaning 'to be', indicating one who is above all and possesses beauty.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Supreetha represents the divine feminine energy and symbolizes grace, beauty, and strength. It is believed to bring blessings of happiness, prosperity, and good fortune.
